Pull Apart Garlic Bread  Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 1 tbsp sugar * 270g milk (about 1 cup + 2 tbsp) * 380g flour (about 3 cups) * 1 tsp salt * 43g softened butter (about 3 tbsp) Butter Mixture * 100g butter, softened * 1 tbsp chopped cilantro * 1 garlic clove, minced * Shredded cheese Instructions 1. Cover and let the dough rest for 2 hours or until doubled. 4. Mix the softened butter with the cilantro and minced garlic. 5. Cut the dough in half, stack one half on top of the other, then cut into strips. Transfer the pieces into a loaf pan. 7. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. 8. Fruity Pebble Ice Cream Taco #shorts #food #recipe Full Recipe 👇🏿 Fruity Pebbles Choco Tacos Yield: 6–8 tacos TOOLS NEEDED Mixing bowls Fine mesh strainer Electric hand mixer Rubber spatula Waffle cone maker Taco shell holder Pastry brush Microwave-safe bowl Ice cream scoop or piping bag --- BEFORE YOU START - Keep the heavy cream very cold and stop whipping just under stiff peaks so the ice cream stays light and creamy. - Shape the waffle taco shells immediately while they are still hot. Once they cool, they will crack instead of bending. - Let the taco shells cool completely before adding the white chocolate, and keep them upright in a taco holder anytime they are setting or freezing. --- FRUITY PEBBLES ICE CREAM Ingredients 2 cups cold heavy whipping cream, divided 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles cereal, for soaking 3/4 cup sweetened condensed milk 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, finely chopped 2 tablespoons caramel sauce Instructions 1. Add 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles to a bowl and pour about 1 1/2 cups of the heavy cream over the cereal. 2. Cover and refrigerate for 2–3 hours. 3. Pour the cereal and cream through a fine mesh strainer into a clean bowl. 4. Press down firmly on the soaked cereal with the back of a spoon or spatula to get as much of the Fruity Pebbles cream out as possible. 5. Discard the soaked cereal. 6. Add enough fresh cold heavy cream to the strained cream to bring it back up to about 2 cups total. 7. Whip the cream until it reaches just under stiff peaks. It should be thick and fluffy but still smooth. 8. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk. 9. Finely chop or crush 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles. 10. Mix the cereal with the caramel sauce. 11. Fold the caramel Fruity Pebbles mixture into the ice cream. 12. Transfer to a freezer-safe container, cover, and freeze for 4–6 hours or until firm enough to scoop. --- WAFFLE TACO SHELLS Ingredients Prepared homemade waffle cone batter Instructions 1. Preheat your waffle cone maker. 2. Add enough batter to make a thin, even waffle and cook until golden brown. 3. As soon as it comes off the waffle cone maker, carefully fold it into a taco shape. 4. Place it in a taco shell holder or taco mold while it cools. 5. Repeat with the remaining batter and let all of the shells cool completely. --- WHITE CHOCOLATE COATING Ingredients 2 cups chopped white chocolate 1–2 tablespoons coconut oil Instructions 1. Add the chopped white chocolate and 1 tablespoon coconut oil to a microwave-safe bowl. 2. Microwave in short intervals, stirring between each one, until completely melted and smooth. 3. Add a little more coconut oil if needed to loosen the chocolate. 4. Brush a thin layer of white chocolate all over the inside of each taco shell, making sure to get down into the bottom curve. 5. Place the shells upright in a taco holder and freeze for about 10 minutes, or until the chocolate is firm. --- ASSEMBLY Ingredients Prepared Fruity Pebbles ice cream Prepared white chocolate-coated taco shells Remaining melted white chocolate 1 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, crushed Instructions 1. Remove the ice cream from the freezer. If it is very firm, let it soften for a few minutes until it is easy to scoop. 2. Fill each taco shell with the Fruity Pebbles ice cream. 3. Press the ice cream gently into the center and sides so the taco is completely filled. 4. Smooth the exposed ice cream across the top. 5. Place the tacos upright in the taco holder and freeze until the ice cream is firm again, about 30–60 minutes. 6. Reheat the remaining white chocolate if needed. 7. Dip the exposed edge of each taco into the white chocolate, rotating from the top toward the bottom in a curved motion so the chocolate follows the shape of the taco. 8. Immediately sprinkle crushed Fruity Pebbles over the wet chocolate. 9. Return the tacos to the freezer until the chocolate is set and the ice cream is completely firm. 10. Keep frozen until ready to serve.

Mini Cinnamon Sugar Donuts! Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 3 tbsp sugar * 110 ml milk (⅓ cup + 2 tbsp) * 1 egg * 280 g flour (≈ 2¼ cups) * 1 tsp salt * 38 g softened butter (≈ 2 tbsp + 2 tsp) Cinnamon Sugar Coating * 140 g sugar (≈ ⅔ cup) * 1 tsp ground cinnamon Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the milk, yeast, and sugar. Add the egg, flour, salt, and softened butter all at once, then mix and coil fold the dough several times. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. Coil fold again, cover, and let rise for 2 hours or until doubled in size. 2. Place your dough onto a work surface and shape it into a long log. Using a knife, cut it into 24 equal pieces. 3. Roll each piece into a ball and place it onto a small square of parchment paper. Gently flatten each one, cover, and let rise for 30 minutes. Uncover and let rest for another 5 minutes before frying. 4. Make sure the oil is hot before frying. Carefully place the donuts into the hot oil, gently remove the parchment paper, and fry until golden on both sides. 5. Mix the sugar and cinnamon together. While the donuts are still warm, coat both sides in the cinnamon sugar. #donuts #donut #bread #breadtok #homemade

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

Nashville Hot Chicken Caesar Sandwich 🌶️ Ingredients Chicken 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, pounded evenly Salt, to taste Oil, for deep-frying Nashville Hot Seasoning 1 tbsp cayenne pepper 2 tbsp brown sugar 1 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp black pepper 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tbsp onion powder 2 tsp salt (Mix all seasoning ingredients together. Some will remain after preparing the chicken, flour, buttermilk, and hot oil.) Seasoned Flour 2 cups all-purpose flour 1/2 cup cornstarch 1 tsp baking powder 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Buttermilk Mixture 2 cups buttermilk 2 large eggs 1 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Nashville Hot Oil 1/2 cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Caesar Dressing 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan 1 tbsp lemon juice 1 tsp Dijon mustard 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce 1 small garlic clove, finely grated 1/2 tsp black pepper 1–2 tbsp cold water, as needed Salt, to taste Caesar Salad 1 cup finely chopped romaine 2–3 tbsp Caesar dressing 1–2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan Assembly 5–6 toasted brioche or rustic buns Dill pickle slices Parmesan cheese Extra Caesar dressing, as needed Instructions Cut chicken into 5–6 sandwich-sized pieces, pound evenly, and season lightly with salt. Whisk all Caesar dressing ingredients until smooth. Add water as needed, adjust salt and lemon, and refrigerate. Mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and 2 tbsp seasoning. In another bowl, whisk buttermilk, eggs, and 1 tbsp seasoning. Coat chicken in flour, dip in buttermilk, then coat in flour again, pressing to create a craggy crust. Rest on a wire rack for 5–10 minutes. Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry in batches until golden and crispy and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C). Drain on a wire rack. Carefully whisk 2 tbsp seasoning into 1/2 cup hot frying oil. Brush a thin layer over both sides of the chicken, adjusting to taste. Creamy Tuscan White Beans Ingredients (4-5 servings): • 2 (15-oz) cans white beans, Great Northern or cannellini, drained and rinsed • 1½ cups cherry tomatoes, halved • ⅓ cup sun-dried tomatoes, chopped • 1 small yellow onion, finely diced • 4 garlic cloves, finely minced • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¼ tsp red pepper flakes, plus more to taste • 1 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups broth • ½ cup whole milk • 1 tsp Dijon mustard • ½ cup finely grated Parmesan, plus more for serving • 2–3 cups chopped kale, tough stems removed • 1 tbsp lemon juice • 1 tsp honey • ½ tsp freshly ground black pepper • Salt, to taste • Extra-virgin olive oil, for finishing • Crusty sourdough, for serving Instructions: 1. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add the olive oil and diced onion with a pinch of salt. Cook for 4-5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly golden. 2. Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they’re blistered and beginning to collapse. Reserve some of the blistered tomatoes for later. 3. Add garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook for 30-60 seconds until fragrant.  4. Stir in Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, red pepper flakes and black pepper. 5. Sprinkle flour over everything and stir for about 30 seconds. Slowly pour in the broth while stirring, followed by the milk and Dijon mustard. 6. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring, until slightly thickened. 7. Stir in the beans and simmer gently for 5–7 minutes.  8. Mash about ⅓ of the beans against the side of the skillet with the back of a spoon. 9. Stir in the chopped kale, cover, and cook for 3-5 minutes, stirring once or twice, until tender but still vibrant. 10. Lower the heat and stir in the Parmesan until melted and glossy. 11. Add lemon juice and honey. Taste and adjust salt, pepper and red pepper flakes. If the sauce is thicker than you want, stir in a splash of broth. 12. Top with the reserved blistered tomatoes, Parmesan, black pepper and a drizzle of olive oil. Enjoy! #beans #whitebeans #fallrecipes #easydinner #dinneridea

Tennessee Onions! 🧅🧀 aka sliced onion rings that are roasted until soft and jammy, then covered in a three cheese blend and broiled until the top is deep golden brown and bubbling.  Get the full recipe at https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/tennessee-onions/ or click the link in our profile and it will take you straight there. Try it for the holidays, or try it sooner with roast chicken or steak and potatoes for a cozy weeknight dinner!  Butter for greasing the dish 2½ pounds Vidalia onions or another sweet onion; about 3 large, sliced ½ inch thick and separated into rings 2 tablespoons butter melted ½ teaspoon beef base Better Than Bouillon 1 teaspoon dried thyme 1 teaspoon dried parsley ½ teaspoon dried oregano ½ teaspoon dry mustard ½ teaspoon smoked paprika ½ teaspoon garlic powder ¾ teaspoon kosher salt ¼ teaspoon black pepper ⅛ teaspoon cayenne pepper ½ cup low-moisture mozzarella shredded (about 2 oz) ¾ cup sharp cheddar shredded (about 3 oz) ½ cup grated Parmesan Preheat the oven to 400˚F. Butter a 9x13 baking dish on the bottom and sides. Slice the onions ½ inch thick, then separate each slice into individual rings. Keep the rings whole as much as you can, but a few broken ones are fine. Whisk the beef base into the melted butter until smooth. To a very large bowl, add the onion rings and the butter mixture and toss until every ring is coated. Sprinkle the thyme, parsley, oregano, dry mustard, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper and cayenne over the top. Set a second bowl of about the same size upside down over the first and shake until the onions are evenly coated. Arrange the rings in the buttered dish so they lie mostly flat and intact. They don't need to be in perfect rows, but don't pile them in a heap. Roast, uncovered, for 35 to 40 minutes, until the onions are very soft and starting to color at the edges. If they begin to brown too quickly, lay a sheet of foil loosely over the top for the remaining time. (The goal is to drive off moisture, so don't crimp the foil tightly.) Remove the dish from the oven. If there is liquid pooled in the bottom, sop it up with paper towels. Too much liquid will make the cheese gummy underneath. Scatter the mozzarella and cheddar over the onions, then the Parmesan. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until the cheese is melted and just starting to brown. Switch the oven to broil and broil until the top is deep golden brown and bubbling, watching closely the whole time. Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
